text: My education and qualifications are: I have proudly served Albany as a former Mayor, Vice Mayor and current councilmember addressing collective goals around equity, opportunity, and empowerment. I made right on my promise when elected as the 1st ever Latino, to bring in a new era of leadership that would move Albany forward intentionally and responsibly. I have a proven track record of empowering Albany to actualize its potential, having delivered results while Mayor, that include but aren’t limited to achieving a balanced budget, divesting from fossil fuels, and supporting the revival of Dinner With Albany for our community. I am committed to Albany’s future, sensible housing, enhanced access to basic needs, advancing initiatives for equitable and accessible infrastructure, and supporting evidence-based policy that is culturally and socially relevant. As a father to young children in Albany, the future of our city is personal. I am proud to be endorsed by Albany City Councilmembers and past Mayors John Miki & Preston Jordan, Albany School Board President Josh Mahoney, Albany School Board Trustees Sadia Khan & Becky Hopwood, State Senator Jesse Arregufn, Berkeley Mayor Adena Ishii, Contra Costa County Supervisor John Gioia and many others. Visit Albanyforward.org. Friends, rank Robin López #1 on your ballot!

text: My education and qualifications are: Albany welcomed my son and me and gave us a home. As Sammy grew from a kindergartner into a UC Davis student, I became deeply involved in serving the community that embraced us. I’m president of the Albany Community Foundation, serve on the Albany Y board, spent nearly ten years on the Albany Education Foundation board, and founded Albany’s Pride. Running my small business for nearly twenty years has taught me to set priorities, make every dollar count, and answer for the results. I’m running on one promise: a relentless focus on Albany. That means safer streets, citywide traffic calming and sidewalks seniors can trust; a transparent City budget, with a clear public plan to replace approximately $1.1 million in annual revenue tied to Golden Gate Fields as it moves toward becoming a waterfront park; Solano and San Pablo Avenues where local businesses can open, stay, and thrive; and room for the families, teachers, and seniors who make Albany work. I’m proud to be endorsed by Mayor Peggy McQuaid and Vice Mayor Jennifer Hansen-Romero. I’ll listen first, decide in the open, and report back. I’d be honored to earn your vote and your #1 ranking. jondestin.com

text: My education and qualifications are: I grew up in Albany, graduated from UC Berkeley with a BA in American History, and then studied film theory and practice at SFSU. I lived and worked in the Berkeley Students Co-ops and remain a proponent of self-governing cooperatives. I believe government should express a generosity of spirit and strive to be open and anti-authoritarian. I believe inclusivity is founded on pluralism, freedom of choice, and separation of church and state. I am the founder of Context By Signal (contextbysignal.com), a web service offering wireless network analysis from an environmental perspective. My interests include ensuring that the voices of home owners and tenants can be heard, whether by increased opportunities for discussion or meaningful processes for feedback and complaint. I would like to talk about housing speculation and how we can minimize the price of housing for future generations. Local codes should be updated for the digital era including standards for privacy and encroachment. We should talk about the impact of wireless tech on the residential “noise floor” and how tech coexists with older homes using traditional infrastructure. Local government matters nationally. I’d like to ensure the block coordinator program is democratic and has appropriate oversight.

text: My education and qualifications are: Albany has always been my home; I feel lucky to have grown up here and I want to do everything I can to make it a better place and give back to my community. That is why I ran for Council in 2020, why I served as Councilmember, Vice-Mayor, and Mayor between 2020 & 2024, and why I have continued to give back since leaving the Council. In my time on Council I was proud to secure $600,000 in annual funding from UC Berkeley for our Fire Department and city services, keeping our budget intact when Golden Gate Fields closed. I believe our City should be guided by smart, progressive policymaking, and I know that I can help lead with the values that our community shares. Professionally, I work for the Alameda County Housing and Community Development Department creating affordable housing. I serve as the Chair of the City’s Housing Advisory Commission and the President of the School District’s Citizen Bond Oversight Committee. I am proud to be endorsed by Albany City Councilmembers and past Mayors John Miki & Preston Jordan, Albany School Board President Josh Mahoney, and Albany School Board Trustees Sadia Khan & Becky Hopwood, State Senator Jesse Arreguin, Berkeley Mayor Adena Ishii, Former State Senator Nancy Skinner and many others. Visit Albanyforward.org. Please rank me #1 on your ballot. Candidate’s Statement CITY OF ALBANY FOR MEMBERS OF CITY COUNCIL

text: My education and qualifications are: For the past 27 years, I have proudly called Albany home, serving as a resident, volunteer, coach, parent, and public servant. As my son grew up here, I supported our schools through fundraising and student programs and spent many years coaching Little League baseball, where I became known as “Coach Chris.” Coaching allowed me to mentor young people and teach teamwork, accountability, and respect. Professionally, I bring more than 30 years of public service with the City and County of San Francisco, serving in Emergency Management, the Department of Public Works, and the Public Utilities Commission, where I have been entrusted with managing operations, budgets, and capital programs totaling billions of dollars. My career has given me extensive experience in government operations, infrastructure, emergency preparedness, strategic planning, budgeting, and delivering high-quality public services. This combination of community involvement and professional experience has prepared me to serve Albany effectively. I am committed to responsible stewardship of public resources, organizational efficiency, and thoughtful long-term planning. Above all, I lead with integrity and collaboration, listening, building partnerships, and helping ensure Albany remains an exceptional place to live, work, and raise a family.
